messages:
Ethan K: Heads up — expense claim from @Lina for the DevWeek sponsor dinner. She says the corpcard was declined in Santiago so she paid on her personal card. The vendor invoice we got is issued to "RedWood Labs S.A." but our corpcard transaction shows "Redwood, Inc." Vendor VAT ID in the invoice doesn't match the onboarding record. Total CLP 340,000 (approx $420). I attached invoice + personal card statement to the expense. Do we need the vendor to re-issue, or can we reimburse as-is? Also this is >$400 — manager approval required?

Maya F (Finance): Short answer: we can reimburse the employee, but we need a couple of things before AP processes payment.
1) Manager approval for personal-card travel > $250.
2) Corrected invoice from the vendor issued to "Redwood Inc." OR a vendor-signed explanatory letter if they can’t reissue.
3) Proof of card decline (screenshot or bank message) + the itemized receipt.
4) If VAT was charged, confirm who is responsible (we need vendor tax ID).
Please upload everything to Concur/Expensify and tag GL code `6010-Travel-Events`.

expense-bot: Automatic reminder — travel personal-card reimbursements over $250 require manager approval and vendor verification. Policy: https://redwood.infra/expenses-policy#travel. Use expense code `TRV-SPONSOR` and attach `invoice.pdf` and `card-statement.pdf`.

Sam R (Manager): Approved — I sign off on reimbursing Lina for the sponsor dinner. Posting approval here so finance has it. :white_check_mark:

Jess A (AP): Thanks Sam. Two quick asks from AP side:
- If vendor can reissue an invoice, perfect. If not, we can accept a vendor-signed letter confirming the billing name + VAT rationale as a fallback.
- For FX handling: reimburse in USD equivalent using the date-of-charge exchange rate. Please include the bank statement showing the conversion (if available).
I'll plan to code to 6010 and create a vendor exception in Coupa if the vendor name mismatch persists.

Ethan K: Lina just uploaded the bank statement and a screenshot of the decline to the Concur expense. I also pinged procurement to request a reissued invoice with "Redwood, Inc." and our vendor tax ID. ETA 48 hours. If procurement doesn't get it in time, Jess — can AP proceed with the vendor letter fallback?

Jess A (AP): Yes — vendor letter + manager attestation is an acceptable fallback. We'll mark the expense as "pending vendor docs" and process once we have either the reissued invoice or the signed letter. Flagging for audit but okay to proceed. Processing time 2-3 business days after docs are complete.

Maya F (Finance): Great, thanks. Quick checklist for Lina: 1) Manager approval (done) 2) Upload vendor invoice or signed letter 3) Upload bank/card decline screenshot 4) Tag expense `TRV-SPONSOR` and GL `6010-Travel-Events`. Once Jess confirms docs, AP will reimburse.

Ethan K: Noted. I'll follow up with procurement and keep the thread updated. Thanks all.
